_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
v3.2.125

The launcher verifies attached firmware identity before using a workstation flash receipt. A silent controller blocks launch without erase; disconnected offline use remains available. Two queued supervisors no longer reinstall or reopen an identical application release. Explicit same-branch version pins remain supported.

Includes measured-rate PID diagnostics and consistent SysID status from the previous display updates. Controller firmware and stored calibration/tuning are unchanged. Experimental controller359 is withheld pending tracking, pulse and GUI/standalone qualification.
